All 37 native card portions, 72 printed physical input targets, 33 declared output endpoints, route crossings, captions, continuations and footer were compared with the original TIFF. Root independently reviewed the corrected final preview.
Two printed diamond joins are modeled as one physical net each with both physical output endpoints: AQ.OUT40+AV.B07 at 115,35; BK.G03+BP.D02 at 154,68.
BA to BK row73 has a subcell toner dropout, not a full-cell cap; BB to BK row74 bears literal inline L. Native same-page comparisons are in scratch.

BK first input: source prints a wire elbow followed by numeral 6, not literal L6. BK final input: 5K belongs to the card grid inside the border; source outside pin is blank and an L is printed inline farther left.
Source-versus-A1 discrepancy: native BQ card portion at 7J reads 3308U1, with open-top U. A1 lists 3308D1 at B-E2H7; printed source glyph is preserved and the one unmatched A1 portion is declared.
Source AS 4C function reads BR: its first glyph has two closed lobes and a middle stroke, unlike the open interior of clear AR 4B OR on the same TIFF.
Native BH -IND PADDL 51 continuation reads KT531. Lower CLOCK P3 EXTENDED row87 has outlined-diamond separator before SHIFT R1, while upper CLOCK row65 has a plus separator.
